items.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: Michael Max and I shared a compartment, because we have a very good intellectual relationship apart from the music... And we played in a huge concert hall up there.

ctx.x: Yul Brynner, yeah. Yul Brynner’s parents have a house that’s still there in Vladivostok. They had mining interests. They apparently paved the roads in Vladivostok. Well Khabarovsk is a city of 600,000 north 12 hours by train, and so we had sleeping compartments and Michael Max and I shared a compartment, because we have a very good intellectual relationship apart from the music, and we could look in across the Amur River into China. And we played in a huge concert hall up there. Now if I can move, I want to show…
